verdict.rationale: Crossmint is fundamentally API-first: headless checkout REST APIs, server-side API keys, webhooks for async event tracking, and agent wallets that execute onchain actions with 'no user prompt per action' all point to programmatic, automatable operation outside any UI/browser context (explicitly including non-browser environments like games/VR). This directly supports headless/CI-style automation of wallet, payment, and agent-checkout flows. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline examples or a dedicated CLI, and no independent hands-on report confirming automated/CI usage in practice.
